description.text:
McGill-NLP/AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1 fine-tuned with LoRA (rank 16, all linear layers), merged into the base weights on israel/AfriGuard-inst: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt, and the target is <safety>…</safety> <category>…</category> <response>…</response>.

This is a rerun of the AfriGuard-inst config afriguard_lora_sft.yaml from the AfriGuard-model (LlamaFactory) repo, with only the output paths changed (examples/train_lora/afriguard_inst_afriqueqwen3.5-4b-50langs-instruct_lora_sft.yaml), made as the matched baseline for adzcai/AfriGuardPlain-AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1-lora-merged, the same setup trained on adzcai/AfriGuard-plain (no instruction, no tags). 1 epoch, 1 GPU, chat template of the base model, loss on the response only.

quotes: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt
<safety>safe|unsafe</safety> <category>top_category (always, for safe and unsafe prompts)</category> <response>final reply</response>

serving.notes: No adapter_config.json. The weight index lists 297 tensors under model.visual, so the merged checkpoint includes a vision tower. generation_config.json sets only eos, pad, and use_cache. Modelfile sets PARAMETER stop <|im_end|> and PARAMETER num_ctx 4096, and its TEMPLATE has an optional system slot but no system text. The card prose says 1 GPU; the hyperparameter block says distributed_type: multi-GPU. Framework versions include PEFT 0.18.1. No trainer_state.json is in the repository, so the step count is not in the repo.
